trigger.rule: H8 registered terminal FAIL and its preregistration mandates route review after FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE

questions: Which H8 gates passed and failed without reclassifying H8?
Does code evidence localize the failed calibration repair to catch-up loss/target fitting rather than actor/trunk leakage?
Is a robust catch-up-only critic loss the smallest upstream single-variable successor that preserves the mirror signal?
Do H3/H4/H5 asset or resolver routes have stronger frozen launch permission, or is the hybrid family exhausted?
candidate_actions: H9 replace only value-head catch-up MSE with a preregistered robust loss
H9 reduce catch-up learning rate or epochs
alter target-KL or relax failed gates
engineering-only return-target/outlier audit before behavior registration
decision_rule: Select an H9 robust catch-up-loss window only if H8 is a valid fixed-sample FAIL, actor/trunk isolation and catch-up accounting passed, both fixed mirrors strongly passed, calibration failed clearly, code proves catch-up alone repeats unweighted squared-error fitting on clipped high-variance returns, and the new window can freeze every other behavior variable. If robust-loss scale cannot be fixed without outcome-driven tuning, select engineering-only target/outlier evidence first. Gate relaxation, H8 adoption, official hands and action-specific tuning are forbidden.
inference_limits: H8 is one training seed and internal mirrors are not external strength. Route selection may support only a prospective same-start mechanism experiment.
